original.name: isNat_clog
original.statement: {b nb n nn k : ℕ} → IsNat b nb → IsNat n nn → Nat.clog nb nn = k → IsNat (Nat.clog b n) k | _, _, _, _, _, ⟨rfl⟩, ⟨rfl⟩, rfl => ⟨rfl⟩  /-- Given the natural number literals `eb` and `en`, returns `Nat.clog eb en` as a natural number literal and an equality proof. Panics if `ex` or `en` aren't natural number literals. -/ def proveNatClog (eb en : Q(ℕ)) : (ek : Q(ℕ)) × Q(Nat.clog $eb $en = $ek)
